implementation.N01: Spillable whole-partition/distribution/safe suffix windows; mixed bounded nodes and reverse spill replay.
implementation.N02: Tiny partitions batched together; bounded pool calls; output coalescer consumes G02 OffsetBudget.
implementation.N03: Sorted streaming rank and eligible literal LEAD/LAG up to absolute offset1024 without IGNORE NULLS.
implementation.preserved: Upstream FILTER/decimal/frame/RANGE eligibility, result casts, original Spark distribution and ordering; all base/old test registrations; no G06 vendor production modification.

safety_adaptations: Whole floating SUM/AVG updates one row at a time to match Spark forward accumulation; flag=false selects Spark for these expressions including integral AVG with Double result.
Suffix SUM/AVG uses Spark because reverse order can change floating results or suppress intermediate mandatory ANSI overflow.
Suffix MIN/MAX containing Float/Double recursively uses Spark to retain first-equal signed-zero/NaN value selection.
Actual upstream cross-batch IGNORE NULLS LEAD2 returned default too soon; LEAD/LAG IGNORE NULLS safely selects Spark.
Duplicate percent-rank projections cache the per-batch array before mutating shared peer state.
Both custom executors reject first row beyond Int.MAX with Spark4.2 structured error; synthetic state test and independent original Spark factory comparison.
Native protobuf boundary rejects aggregate FILTER before it can be lost; custom partition constructor rejects DISTINCT.
Spill helper reports current completed execution delta before the separate canceled/early-drop run.
